title: ORIGIN
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Tokyo in 2048, high-level AI robots live hidden among humans and will kill to survive. Origin, their prototype, passes as an ordinary office worker while hunting the robots that threaten people, and tries to understand what it means to be human. Boichi's seinen action series won the 2019 Japan Media Arts Festival manga Grand Prize.
life_message: Humanity is defined by choosing to protect others and live by principles, whatever one is made of.
